mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPI below 2.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 1.5% year-over-year, it signals robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,200,000 units annually, it indicates strong residential construction that stimulates economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production and GDP growth signals a robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 are growing.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth consistently indicates healthy consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising.
